question: How many users are there in each age category (20s, 30s, 40s, 50s, and others)?
sql:
WITH user_ages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT user_id,
        CAST(date_diff('year', birth_date::DATE, CURRENT_DATE) AS INTEGER) as age_years
    FROM mst_users
),
categories AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN age_years BETWEEN 20 AND 29 THEN '20s'
            WHEN age_years BETWEEN 30 AND 39 THEN '30s'
            WHEN age_years BETWEEN 40 AND 49 THEN '40s'
            WHEN age_years BETWEEN 50 AND 59 THEN '50s'
            ELSE 'others'
        END AS age_category
    FROM user_ages
)
SELECT
    age_category,
    COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM categories
GROUP BY age_category
ORDER BY
    CASE age_category
        WHEN '20s' THEN 1
        WHEN '30s' THEN 2
        WHEN '40s' THEN 3
        WHEN '50s' THEN 4
        WHEN 'others' THEN 5
    END
